artifacts.title: Primary action
artifacts.summary: The single dominant affirmative action of a surface, rendered as a solid accent-blue button; dismiss and secondary actions are ghost buttons.

states: default: solid accent fill var(--color-accent) #2563eb, white text, 1px transparent border
hover: var(--color-accent-hover) #1d4ed8
focus-visible: 2px var(--color-accent) outline, offset 2px
compact (bulk bar): .btn-sm padding 6px 12px, font-size 0.85rem
a11y: keyboard focusable with a visible accent focus ring
one dominant primary action per surface; secondary controls are ghost
do: use the shared .btn base so radius (10px) and typography (sans 600) stay consistent
reserve .btn-primary for the single dominant affirmative action
dont: do not use a raw accent hex in the component; reference var(--color-accent)
do not give one surface two solid primary buttons
body.statement: Primary actions are solid accent-blue (.btn.btn-primary); dismiss and secondary actions are ghost (.btn.btn-ghost).

artifacts.title: Destructive confirmation
artifacts.summary: A destructive action opens the shared modal confirmation with a ghost Cancel and a solid danger accept; per-row triggers use the quieter danger-ghost role.

states: trigger placement: row action (.bookmark-delete) or the bulk toolbar Delete
per-row trigger: .btn-danger-ghost transparent fill, danger text var(--color-danger) #b91c1c, ghost border, hover tint #fef2f2
dialog: centered overlay rgba(20,24,33,0.45) over a surface dialog, radius 10px, shadow 0 12px 32px rgba(20,24,33,0.22)
accept: solid .btn-danger fill #b91c1c, white text, focused by default
dismiss: Cancel (ghost), Escape, backdrop click; post-action feedback: none
a11y: role=dialog aria-modal=true, labelled by the confirmation title
Escape dismisses and focus moves to the accept action
do: name the target and state the consequence ("This can't be undone.")
generalise one dialog by carrying a pending target (bulk count or single bookmark)
dont: do not use solid .btn-danger for a per-row trigger; use .btn-danger-ghost
do not delete without a confirmation
body.statement: Destructive actions use a shared modal: Cancel (ghost) plus a solid danger accept, with Escape/backdrop dismissal; per-row triggers are danger-ghost.

artifacts.title: Empty state
artifacts.summary: Zero-content states use the centered .empty-state card: a title, a muted explanation, and one action; the filter-empty variant names the active tag and offers a ghost Clear filter.

states: first-run: shown when there are no bookmarks; the list is hidden and the action is a primary CTA
filtered-empty: shown when a filter is active and no bookmark matches; names the active tag and offers a ghost Clear filter
card: white var(--color-surface), 1px dashed var(--color-border), radius 10px, padding 48px 24px, centered
title 1.15rem; body muted var(--color-muted) with max-width 42ch
a11y: the explanation text is real text, not an image
each state exposes exactly one clear next action
do: keep the empty-state card family for every zero-content state
let the filter-empty variant name the tag that produced no matches
dont: do not show the first-run copy for a filtered, still-populated collection
do not present a zero-content screen with no action
body.statement: Zero-content screens render the centered .empty-state card with one action; filter-empty is the recorded variant that names the active tag.

tests: golden: empty state with no bookmarks

artifacts.title: Form validation
artifacts.summary: Forms validate on submit: offending fields get a danger border and aria-invalid, the message lands in the single form-error alert, and typing clears it.

states: validation timing: on submit (form carries novalidate)
invalid field: danger border var(--color-danger) #b91c1c plus aria-invalid=true
message: one .add-form-error summary node, role=alert, danger-coloured
recovery: typing in the field clears its error and hides the message
do: validate title required and URL required plus plausible, with human messages
reuse the identical path for the add and edit forms
dont: do not validate live or before submit in this project
do not render a duplicate message per field
body.statement: Form validation is on submit: danger border + aria-invalid on the field, one form-error alert for the message, auto-clear on input.
body.quote: app.js: handleSubmit marks .is-invalid and shows one form-error; styles.css .field input.is-invalid{border-color:var(--color-danger)}

artifacts.title: Tags and chips
artifacts.summary: Tags render as accent-soft pill chips; the filter row reuses the same chip family with a solid-accent active state; the comma-separated tag field trims and case-insensitively dedupes.

states: chip: accent-soft bg var(--color-accent-soft) #eff4ff, accent text var(--color-accent) #2563eb, pill radius 999px, sans 600 0.78rem, padding 2px 10px
filter chip: same family, padding 4px 12px, transparent border, accent border on hover
active chip: solid accent bg #2563eb, white text, aria-pressed=true
tag field: comma-separated; values are trimmed and case-insensitively deduped (parseTags); a tag with no users loses its chip
a11y: filter chips are buttons exposing aria-pressed
tags are edited through the shared comma-separated field
do: reuse the .tag chip family for card tags and filter chips
recompute the tag facets after any tag mutation
dont: do not introduce a status-label vocabulary; none exists in this project
do not render duplicate tags on a bookmark
body.statement: Tags are accent-soft pill chips; filter chips reuse the family and invert to solid accent when active; parseTags trims and case-insensitively dedupes.

artifacts.title: Surfaces
artifacts.summary: Cards and the form/edit panel share one surface token set: white fill, 1px hairline border, 10px radius and the standard shadow; the bulk bar is the recorded accent-soft, shadowless variant.

states: default surface: white var(--color-surface), 1px solid var(--color-border), radius 10px var(--radius), shadow var(--shadow)
bulk-bar variant: accent-soft fill #eff4ff, 1px accent border, radius 10px, no shadow (documented deviation)
selected card: accent border plus accent-soft tint (.is-selected)
edit panel reuses the add-form surface exactly (edit-panel on .form-panel)
a11y: surface boundaries remain visible without colour (hairline border)
interactive surfaces keep a visible focus style
do: compose a card from a title, a muted URL and optional tag chips
reuse the same token set for cards, panels and the confirmation dialog
dont: do not introduce a new radius or shadow for a card-like surface
do not add a shadow to the bulk bar
body.statement: Surfaces share one token set (white fill, 1px --color-border hairline, 10px radius, --shadow); the bulk bar is the recorded accent-soft, shadowless variant.
